title: Google's New Model Writes the Code for You! 💻
body: Google's New Model Writes the Code for You! 💻

On November 18, Google announced a new model called Gemini 4 Neon, the fourth in the Gemini 4 family in just weeks. The model is aimed at coding and long tasks: it writes code, reviews errors, and works as an agent that carries out multi-step tasks on your behalf.

Context window is the amount of text a model can remember in one go — here it reaches one million tokens, roughly hundreds of pages. And the price for developers is $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
Google says it topped the coding-agent benchmark at 58.6%, but those figures come from Google's own announcement and have not yet been independently verified.
Would you let an AI assistant write the code instead of you? 🤖
